headline: Fixed errors when interacting with dungeon vendors and after emptying item slots.

entries.title: Error when visiting merchants in dungeons or raids
entries.details: Interacting with vendors inside instances no longer causes an error when the game restricts merchant identity information.

entries.title: Error after emptying an item slot
entries.details: Fixed an error that could occur when selling, consuming, or equipping an item that leaves a slot empty while bag data is recalculating.
